name: frame-ai
description: FRAME AI video editor: a pane with media, preview, timeline and properties; Claude edits the timeline through its tools; FFmpeg renders MP4 locally.

ffmpegPath.title: FFmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Full path to ffmpeg (ffmpeg.exe on Windows). Leave empty to use ffmpeg from PATH.

ffprobePath.title: ffprobe path
ffprobePath.description: Full path to ffprobe. Leave empty to use ffprobe from PATH, or the one next to the FFmpeg path.

projectsDir.title: Projects folder
projectsDir.description: Where projects are saved. Leave empty for a 'FRAME AI Projects' folder in your home directory.

fontFile.title: Title font file
fontFile.description: A .ttf/.otf file used for titles and subtitles. Leave empty to pick a system font automatically.

whisperModel.title: Whisper model file (optional)
whisperModel.description: Path to a whisper.cpp ggml model, enabling automatic subtitles when your FFmpeg has the whisper filter (FFmpeg 8+).

askBeforeDestructive.title: Ask before destructive edits
askBeforeDestructive.description: Ask before cutting ranges, deleting clips or replacing an export. Turn off only for unattended runs.
